prompt: 工廠地上有油，你要提醒同事小心。哪一句最合適？
options: Watch out! The floor is slippery.
Look at! The floor is slippery.
Watch out! The floor slips.
answer: Watch out! The floor is slippery.

look at 後面要接受詞，不能單獨當警告；警告用 Watch out。
floor 不會自己滑，描述地面狀態要用形容詞 slippery。

why: Watch out! 是提醒小心的常用語，slippery 是濕滑的。
say: Watch out! The floor is slippery.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: You must wear safety glasses in this area.
You must wearing safety glasses in this area.
You must to wear safety glasses in this area.
answer: You must wear safety glasses in this area.

wrong.You must wearing safety glasses in this: 助動詞 must 後面接原形動詞，不能用 wearing。

why: must + 原形動詞，表示必須。
tip: must 後面直接接原形動詞。
say: You must wear safety glasses in this area.

text: Do not touch the machine while it is _____.
options: running
run
runs

wrong.run: it is 後面要接 V-ing 表示進行中，不能用原形 run。
wrong.runs: is 後面不能再接第三人稱動詞 runs。

why: is running 表示機器正在運轉。
say: Do not touch the machine while it is running.

text: WARNING: Flammable liquid. Keep away from heat.
options: 警告：易燃液體，遠離熱源
警告：食用液體，請加熱
警告：冷卻液，請放進冰箱
answer: 警告：易燃液體，遠離熱源

wrong.警告：食用液體，請加熱: Flammable 是易燃，不是可食用；Keep away from heat 是遠離熱。
wrong.警告：冷卻液，請放進冰箱: 標示沒有提到冷卻液，也不是放冰箱，而是遠離熱。

why: Flammable 是易燃的，Keep away from heat 表示遠離熱。

prompt: 消防警報響了，領班要大家離開。哪一句最合適？
options: Please leave the building by the nearest exit.
Please leave the building by the nearest entrance machine.
Please left the building by the nearest exit.
answer: Please leave the building by the nearest exit.

wrong.Please leave the building by the nearest: entrance machine 不是自然說法，疏散要走出口 exit。
wrong.Please left the building by the nearest: please 後面接原形動詞，leave 不能用過去式 left。

why: 疏散要走最近的出口 exit，祈使句用原形 leave。
tip: 疏散：leave by the nearest exit。
say: Please leave the building by the nearest exit.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Always turn off the power before you clean the machine.
Always turn off the power after you clean the machine.
Always turned off the power before you clean the machine.
answer: Always turn off the power before you clean the machine.

wrong.Always turn off the power after you clea: 清潔機器之後才關電是危險的，安全順序應是先關電再清潔。
wrong.Always turned off the power before you c: 這是祈使句，動詞要用原形 turn。

why: 安全規則：清潔前要先關電源。
say: Always turn off the power before you clean the machine.

text: Workers must wear ear protection _____ the noise level is high.
options: when
unless
although

wrong.unless: unless 表示除非，語意變成噪音高時反而不用戴。
wrong.although: although 是雖然，語意轉折不合邏輯。

why: 噪音大時要戴耳塞，用 when 表示當……時。
say: Workers must wear ear protection when the noise level is high.

prompt: The exit is blocked. 意思是什麼？
options: 出口被擋住了
出口已經打開
出口在左邊

wrong.出口已經打開: blocked 是被堵住，與開啟相反。
wrong.出口在左邊: 句子裡沒有提到方向 left，blocked 說的是被擋住的狀態。

why: is blocked 為被動，表示出口被擋住。

prompt: 同事沒戴手套就要搬鋒利的金屬板。你應該說？
options: Wait, you need gloves for that.
Wait, you need glove for these.
Wait, you needs gloves for that.
answer: Wait, you need gloves for that.

手套通常成雙，要用複數 gloves，且 glove 與 these 搭配也不一致。
主詞 you 搭配 need，不加 s。

why: gloves 通常用複數；you need 是正確的現在式。
say: Wait, you need gloves for that.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Report any injury to your supervisor immediately.
Report any injury for your supervisor immediately.
Reporting any injury to your supervisor immediately.
answer: Report any injury to your supervisor immediately.

wrong.Report any injury for your supervisor im: report ... to 某人 才表示向某人報告，for 不對。
wrong.Reporting any injury to your supervisor: 指令要用原形動詞開頭，Reporting 不是完整的指令。

why: report A to B 表示向 B 報告 A。
say: Report any injury to your supervisor immediately.

text: Keep the work area clean and _____.
options: tidy
tidily
tide

wrong.tidily: and 前面是形容詞 clean，後面也要用形容詞 tidy，不是副詞。
wrong.tide: tide 是潮汐，拼字相近但意思不同。

why: clean and tidy 兩個形容詞並列，描述 work area。
tip: 並列要同詞性：clean and tidy。
say: Keep the work area clean and tidy.
